earnings.title: VICI PROPERTIES INC. ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS
highlights: Total revenues increased 5.8% year-over-year to $1.1 billion

Net income attributable to common stockholders decreased 55.1% year-over-year to $342.5 million and, on a per share basis, decreased 56.4% year-over-year to $0.31 due to the impact of the change in the CECL allowance for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
Total revenues were $1.1 billion for the quarter, an increase of 5.8% compared to $1.0 billion for the quarter ended September 30, 2025.
Total revenues for the quarter included $132.0 million of non-cash leasing and financing adjustments and $19.0 million of other income.
Declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.46 per share, representing a 2.2% year-over-year increase

quotes.text: In the third quarter of 2026, we grew our quarterly revenue by 5.8% and our AFFO per share by 4.3% year-over-year, once again demonstrating the flow-through efficiency of our business model, and we were pleased to announce our 9th consecutive annual dividend increase since our IPO almost nine years ago.

outlook: Raised AFFO guidance for full year 2026 to between $2,695 million and $2,705 million, or between $2.47 and $2.48 per diluted share
